video_title: LaVar reacts to LaMelo trade to Wolves & says they need Lonzo and Gelo 😂

quotes.speaker: LaVar Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball on the Minnesota Timberwolves acquiring LaMelo Ball
quotes.excerpt: Minnesota Timberwolves, y'all did the coldest move in the game. You went and got that Melo.
quotes.quote: Minnesota Timberwolves, y'all did the coldest move in the game. You went and got that Melo. Yes, but here is the thing, let me give you the recipe. You got to get the other two Ball boys. You get the other two Ball boys, it will be the most watched team ever in the NBA. Trust me when I tell you. You don't think I'm just talking? No, I'm not.

quotes.speaker: LaVar Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball on the impact of reuniting the Ball brothers
quotes.excerpt: Melo can't win it by himself, but I tell you, with his brothers, I guarantee y'all a championship.
quotes.quote: Melo can't win it by himself, but I tell you, with his brothers, I guarantee y'all a championship. The chemistry and the goddamn speed of the game, I never taught my boys to play by themselves, but together, you can't beat them.

quotes.speaker: LaVar Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaVar Ball's message to Anthony Edwards regarding team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: A-Rod, you already a superstar, so you know what to do. You will take a chance.
quotes.quote: And with Ant, A-Rod, you already a superstar, so you know what to do. You will take a chance. So go get them boys. You can get Lonzo damn near for nothing, you can get Gelo damn near for nothing. Guess what? Coming off the bench, starting, team chemistry, morale in the locker room, whatever you want. Wherever them Ball boys are together, can't lose.
